simpleJp: 9/13 昼・受注：アルタベリーで新しい依頼と賞金首をまとめて受ける
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 昼・受注. New city request window: take all available bounties and side quests, get the informant notes, visit local collectors/shopkeepers and prepare the Everfrost Forest trip. Keep the main plot September 22 deadline protected.

simpleJp: 9/13 昼・旅行：常氷樹林へ向かい氷森の魔物を倒す
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 昼・旅行. Combine the Everfrost Forest bounty with Neuras's handled rock relic. Search chest and Golden Beetle locations; use voluntary Runner travel to initiate Basilio's bond.

simpleJp: 9/13 鎧戦車・昼：9/13以降、任意の鎧戦車移動中にバジリオと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 鎧戦車・昼. Basilio R1: Once he becomes a permanent party member around September 13, initiate his Follower bond by talking to him during discretionary Gauntlet Runner travel in daytime. This opens Berserker. The main-story recruitment alone need not immediately grant a bond rank.

simpleJp: 9/13 遺物回収：常氷樹林の遺物を回収し夜にニューラスへ渡す
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 遺物回収. Neuras relic #5 of 6: Take 'The White Beast in the Frozen Forest' (凍てつく森の白き獣), travel to Everfrost Forest (常氷樹林), collect the handled rock (取っ手がついた岩) and give it to Neuras at night aboard the Runner. This advances the fifth of his six relic ranks if the earlier four were delivered.

simpleJp: 9/13 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲33：アルタベリー・ルンルーモ参道南の東壁沿いを調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #33 of 50 — Altabury Rurmumo road south of T junction, eastern wall. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/13 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲34：アルタベリー・ルンルーモ参道北の階段下を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #34 of 50 — Altabury Rurmumo road north of T junction, dead end downstairs on east. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/13 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲35：夜のアルタベリー白峰魔法館入口の壺を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #35 of 50 — Altabury Whitepeak Magic Shop, Skybound Bridge lower level: examine the vase at night. Non-time-consuming pickup; evening-specific store access. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/13 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲36：蒼穹橋上層の武器屋と雑貨屋の間の柱を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #36 of 50 — Altabury upper Skybound Bridge, behind pillar between weapon and general-goods shops. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/13 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲37：アルタベリー歌劇場前広場の東端で採集する
enGuide: Gold Beetle #37 of 50 — Altabury Opera House Square eastern bridge tip. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/13 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲38：アルタベリー天空の酒場の樽の横を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #38 of 50 — Altabury Sky Tavern: beside barrel. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/13 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲40：常氷樹林の南西採集ポイントを調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #40 of 50 — Everfrost Forest: southwestern gathering point. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/13 夜・読書：『よみ・かき・おてほん』を読み始める
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 夜・読書. Basilio's book becomes available after recruitment; first reading, flex to another Runner night if story locked.

simpleJp: 9/13 【受注・時間なし】ディア・フランコ通り下層で『防寒着の素材を届けろ』を受注する
enGuide: 9/13, 受注・時間なし: At Altabury lower Dia Franco Street accept winter-clothing material request; purchase/gather specifically listed material from relevant city/village and hand back to the giver during a return visit. No hard expiry. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/13 【受注・時間なし】歌劇場前広場で『不遜の塔に巣食うものを倒せ』を受注する
enGuide: 9/13, 受注・時間なし: In Altabury Opera House Square pick up Tower of Ascendant bounty, defeat its target on Sept 17 trip and return to same requester for reward. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/13 【受注・時間なし】募兵舎で『凍てつく森の白き獣』を受注する
enGuide: 9/13, 受注・時間なし: Take Everfrost Forest white-beast bounty from recruitment centre, kill target during Sept 13 area excursion, and report at next recruitment centre visit. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/14 昼・期間限定：ジュリアンと討論する
enGuide: Calendar 9/14 昼・期間限定. FINAL limited candidate debate: challenge Julian in Altabury and answer that immediate practical matters also count. This completes the eight debate contenders if all earlier appearances were done.

simpleJp: 9/14 【監査・時間なし】王の資質5の必要条件を確認する
enGuide: September 14 no-time audit (not an additional night activity): check Courage 5 for Alonzo R7, Tolerance 5 for Catherina, Wisdom 5 for Eupha, Imagination 5 and Eloquence 5 for Basilio. Work on any missing virtue with genuinely free slots; don't claim they are all automatically maxed.

simpleJp: 9/14 夜：勇気5でブライハーヴェンのアロンゾに話してランク7にする
enGuide: Calendar September 14 NIGHT (flexible; requires Courage rank 5, Alonzo R6 from Aug 11 and 2-day cooldown). Alonzo R7: talk to Alonzo in Brilehaven Angler's Inn Square to trigger the rank-7 bond. Do not proceed to Daturam/Rank8 before completing this event. If Courage 5 is not ready, defer to the FIRST eligible night before Sept 30 R8 rather than claiming an impossible 9/14 rank.

simpleJp: 9/15 昼：バジリオのランク1から2日後、昼に街で話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/15 昼. Basilio R2: Two days after his first Gauntlet Runner event, approach Basilio in a city/town hub during the day and take the rank-up conversation.

simpleJp: 9/15 夜・遺物報告：ニューラスに回収済み遺物を渡す
enGuide: Calendar 9/15 夜・遺物報告. Submit any still-unreported relic from Everfrost Forest. The relic order is flexible, but all six must be turned in before Neuras R8 can open.

simpleJp: 9/16 昼：説得力4で昼のユーファと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/16 昼. Eupha R6: With Eloquence 4, approach Eupha during a daytime free-action slot at least two days after R5. Her next rank is not a simple two-day chat; complete the Hyperic quest and Wisdom 5 first.

simpleJp: 9/16 夜：9/13以降、夜のアルタベリー蒼穹橋でキャゼリナと話す
jpGuide1: 夜のアルタベリーの蒼穹橋
enGuide: Calendar 9/16 夜. Catherina R5: After winning her three earlier road challenges, find Catherina from September 13 onward at Altabury's Skybound Bridge (蒼穹橋) at NIGHT. If missing, ensure the Tower of Insolence Gauntlet Runner fight for her R4 happened.

simpleJp: 9/16 【受注・時間なし】ユーファ6達成後『暴走するハイペリックを止めろ』を受注する
enGuide: 9/16, 受注・時間なし: After Eupha R6, speak to the quest-giver on Altabury Skybound Bridge to unlock Mt Vulkano Hyperic request. Defeat the target during Sept 18 Vulkano trip, report it and satisfy Wisdom 5 before Eupha R7 Oct 1. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/17 昼・攻略：不遜の塔の依頼を達成する
enGuide: Calendar 9/17 昼・攻略. Optional combat dungeon; gather unique treasure and any beetle before leaving. Avoid scheduling a town day/night social action on the same dungeon's travel day unless the Runner legitimately provides it.

simpleJp: 9/17 鎧戦車・昼：バジリオのランク2から2日後、任意移動中に話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/17 鎧戦車・昼. Basilio R3: During a discretionary daytime Gauntlet Runner journey after the two-day cooldown, approach him in the central passage. Reserve a side-trip; forced story travel may not count.

simpleJp: 9/17 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲41：不遜の塔2階北東を調べる
enGuide: Gold Beetle #41 of 50 — Tower of Ascendant 2F northeastern spot. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/18 昼・攻略：ウルカノ山の依頼を進め、遺物を入手する
enGuide: Calendar 9/18 昼・攻略. Travel to Mt Vulkano; complete the unlocked side-request and pick up Neuras's patchwork sphere plus the rusted greatsword for related quest turn-ins. Avoid duplicate travel later.

simpleJp: 9/18 昼・遺物：ウルカノ山の『つぎはぎの球体』を拾う
enGuide: Calendar 9/18 昼・遺物. Neuras relic #6 of 6: At Mt Vulkano during the linked quest, collect the patchwork sphere and deliver to Neuras on the Runner after returning. With five other relics already handed in this makes all six and unlocks his Jin quest.

simpleJp: 9/18 【収集・時間消費なし】黄金蟲39：ウルカノ山の東のはしごを上り北へ進む
enGuide: Gold Beetle #39 of 50 — Mt Vulkano: ascend eastern ladder from lower floor and search north. This is a collectible interaction during the indicated city visit/dungeon, not an extra daytime activity; if you are traveling on a different date collect upon first access. Independent locations: Game8/GameWith, GAMEX and PowerPyx.

simpleJp: 9/18 夜・読書：『よみ・かき・おてほん』を読み進める
enGuide: Calendar 9/18 夜・読書. Second unique reading session during Mt Vulkano travel.

simpleJp: 9/19 昼：バジリオのランク3から2日後、昼に街で話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/19 昼. Basilio R4: At least two days after his travel R3, meet him in an eligible daytime town hub. The map's bond marker identifies the current city location.

simpleJp: 9/19 夜・遺物報告：ニューラスに六つ目の遺物を渡す
enGuide: Calendar 9/19 夜・遺物報告. Neuras progresses through R7 after all six relic turn-ins. If the relic sequence is incomplete, use the first eligible night to finish; don't assume the sixth relic itself magically completes R8.

simpleJp: 9/19 【報告・時間なし】ハイペリック討伐と不遜の塔の依頼を報告する
enGuide: 9/19, 報告・時間なし: Turn in the Mt Vulkano Hyperic and Tower of Ascendant local requests to their Altabury NPCs, and the Everfrost bounty at recruitment centre. Must be marked completed for Eupha rank progression. No extra full activity slot is assigned for accepting/reporting quests unless the in-game action actually advances time. Verified Japanese source: GameWith quest table.

simpleJp: 9/20 昼・依頼：王都の募兵舎前で兵士に話してジンを探す
jpGuide2: ジンの鎧戦車に向かう
enGuide: Calendar 9/20 昼・依頼. Neuras final bond trigger: after six relic hand-ins talk to the soldier near the recruitment centre / Regalith Cathedral; then take the Runner to Jin's Gauntlet Runner and win the boss battle. Consider Thief Steal for an optional special weapon.

simpleJp: 9/20 昼・依頼：王都の大聖堂付近の兵士に話しかける
jpGuide1: レガリス大聖堂前の募兵舎前にいる大聖堂の警備兵と会話
jpGuide2: 王国軍募兵舎近くにいる兵士
enGuide: Calendar 9/20 昼・依頼. Use actual available prior free slot, not necessarily 10/24. Neuras R8, part 1: After six lost relic hand-ins, go to Grand Trad near the Regalith Grand Cathedral / Royal Army recruitment office and talk to the guard. This opens the 'Petty Thief' / Jin gauntlet-runner encounter; merely talking to Neuras at night will not complete R8.

simpleJp: 9/20 昼・戦闘：鎧戦車でジンの鎧戦車へ向かい戦闘に勝つ
jpGuide1: ジンの鎧戦車に向かう
enGuide: Calendar 9/20 昼・戦闘. Use actual available prior free slot, not necessarily 10/24. Neuras R8, part 2: Use the Runner to travel to Jin's Gauntlet Runner and win the Jin boss fight. Complete the dialogue/reward sequence to finish the Gunner bond.

simpleJp: 9/20 夜：包容力5を得て夜のキャゼリナと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/20 夜. Catherina R6: Requires Tolerance (包容力) 5 and at least two days after R5. Meet her at Altabury Skybound Bridge at night.

simpleJp: 9/21 昼：バジリオのランク4から2日後、昼に街で話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/21 昼. Basilio R5: Two days after R4, talk to Basilio during a daytime town free-action slot. Begin prioritizing Imagination 5 for R6.

simpleJp: 9/21 夜：ジュナのランク6から2日後、夜の鎧戦車で話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/21 夜. Junah R7: Return to the Runner central passage at night after the two-day cooldown; no separate Virtue gate is listed.

simpleJp: 9/22 昼・闘技場：闘技場の金級に挑む
enGuide: Calendar 9/22 昼・闘技場. Continue Coliseum Gold 3 (optional first-run completion); restore party composition afterward. If the story operation is still uncleared, prioritize its deadline first.

simpleJp: 9/22 夜：キャゼリナのランク6から2日後、夜に話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/22 夜. Catherina R7: Two days after R6, meet her again at night on Altabury's Skybound Bridge. Save a further night for R8 once eligible.

simpleJp: 9/23 物語：王都への物語の展開を進める
enGuide: Calendar 9/23 物語. Story-driven chapter transition; do not presume normal free slots. Check rank progress after the scene.

simpleJp: 9/23 物語：9/23の王都への帰還でガリカのランク7を確認する
jpGuide1: メインストーリー進行
enGuide: Calendar 9/23 物語. Gallica R7: Automatic once the September 23 story return to Grand Trad resolves.

simpleJp: 9/24 物語：9/24の物語の戦闘後、ガリカのランク8を確認する
jpGuide1: メインストーリー進行
enGuide: Calendar 9/24 物語. Gallica R8: Automatic after the September 24 main-story battle. This finishes her Mage bond without an optional activity slot.

simpleJp: 9/24 取り逃し注意：エルダの古仙郷・光の広場で黄金蟲を回収する
jpGuide2: 光の広場で黄金蟲を回収
enGuide: Gold Beetle #42 of 50: one-time Sept 24 Eldan Plaza of Light behind collapsed triangular roof; collect before approaching the Prince. Calendar 9/24 取り逃し注意. TRUE MISSABLE: during this one-day visit to Eldan Sanctum, immediately find the Gold Beetle in the Plaza of Light before leaving or triggering the next objective; ordinary return travel is not available. This should be checked BEFORE progressing the plot.

simpleJp: 9/25 物語：次の期限の最終自由期間に備える
enGuide: Calendar 9/25 物語. Story transition into final September 26–October 25 free-action month. Prepare remaining quests, dragon trials, arena, first-run bonds and books in your quest log before taking the final plot mission.
